purpose: Hand-established identity and condition references before scaling. These polygons are teaching annotations on named source images, never locator rules for new patients.
limits: Regional source-labeled presentations are not pixelwise lesion annotations.
Study label 0 is negative for its own condition, not universally healthy tissue.
The 10 mm/2 mm writer calibrations are scan-local measurement codes, not clinical normality.
Teaching replay is a capacity/wiring test, not held-out diagnostic performance.
This reference workset is not a published child or a replacement for the signed parent memory.

categories.question: ACL
categories.subject: acl
categories.identity: Ligament course in the notch, joining anterior tibial and femoral attachments, anterior to the PCL. Bone identity alone does not establish a ligament.

normal.visual_reading: Oblique striated ACL course anterior to the dark curved PCL; report says cruciates normal.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Disorganized ACL course in the notch; this is the previously independently reviewed teaching support. Report localizes a complete midsubstance rupture.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: MCL
categories.subject: mcl
categories.identity: Medial femoral-to-tibial collateral band outside the medial joint margin, identified relative to the bones and fibular side.
categories.altered_reference: Altered band with surrounding injury signal.

normal.visual_reading: Slim dark band along the medial condyle and proximal tibia, opposite the fibula. Official report calls collateral ligaments normal.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Medial collateral course with local surrounding bright injury signal. Previously reviewed support; report names grade-II proximal partial MCL tear.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Medial Meniscus
categories.subject: medial_meniscus
categories.identity: Fibrocartilage at the medial femorotibial joint margin; the compartment is established from knee side and fibular side.
categories.altered_reference: Cleft, loss or displacement of meniscal tissue.

normal.visual_reading: Dark medial joint-margin wedge between the femur and tibia. Report says preserved morphology and signal without tear.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Medial meniscal margin is displaced toward the gutter with abnormal surrounding fluid/interface. The report independently establishes tear and displaced/extruded meniscal tissue; this is its presentation, not a traced root tear.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Lateral Meniscus
categories.subject: lateral_meniscus
categories.identity: Meniscal horn between lateral femoral condyle and tibial plateau, with its horn and compartment retained.
categories.altered_reference: Cleft, loss or displacement of meniscal tissue.

normal.visual_reading: Preserved dark lateral meniscal wedge at the lateral femorotibial margin. The report explicitly says the lateral meniscus is not torn; this replaces the initial anterior-region support, which did not isolate meniscus.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Irregular, displaced lateral meniscal margin and associated interface, on the fibular side. The independent report names complex degenerative lateral meniscal tearing with extrusion; the contour is not a pixelwise tear boundary.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Medial OA
categories.subject: femoral_cartilage
categories.identity: Medial weight-bearing articular surface and its opposing tibial surface; compartment identity precedes the state question.
categories.altered_reference: Loss or irregularity of articular covering.

normal.visual_reading: Medial articular interface. The report explicitly states no medial focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Medial weight-bearing interface with irregular reduced covering and displaced meniscal context. Report establishes medial cartilage loss; the region is scoped to this compartment.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Lateral OA
categories.subject: tibial_cartilage
categories.identity: Lateral tibial articular surface beneath the lateral femoral condyle, not all cartilage from an OA-positive knee.
categories.altered_reference: Focal loss or irregularity of covering.

normal.visual_reading: Lateral articular interface with preserved covering; report explicitly states no focal lateral chondrosis or injury.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Lateral tibial surface and adjacent joint interface; report localizes a high-grade lateral tibial plateau defect. This is the compartment presentation; the exact defect boundary is not claimed.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: PF OA
categories.subject: trochlear_cartilage
categories.identity: Opposed patellar and trochlear articular surfaces in the anterior knee.

normal.visual_reading: Congruent patellofemoral surfaces with covering visible; report explicitly says no chondral lesion.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Irregular patellofemoral interface beneath the patella. Report independently establishes diffuse patellar/trochlear chondrosis; this is a joint-surface presentation, not a claim every covered pixel is diseased.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Effusion
categories.subject: anterior_synovial_recess
categories.identity: Fluid-bearing joint recess bounded by the femur and extensor mechanism; normal fluid is not itself effusion.

normal.visual_reading: Anterior suprapatellar recess contains a thin fluid cleft; report states no knee effusion. Normal here means condition-negative, not zero fluid.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Expanded bright suprapatellar fluid pocket; the report independently calls effusion. The support contains the pocket and its limiting interfaces.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Synovitis
categories.subject: synovium
categories.identity: Synovial lining/recess interface, distinct from fluid alone. Noncontrast regional appearance is interpreted with the independent call.
categories.normal_reference: No conspicuously thickened lining in this presentation.
categories.altered_reference: Irregular or thickened lining in the recess configuration.

normal.visual_reading: Anterior synovial recess interface with little distension and no conspicuous thickened lining at this address. Official Synovitis=0 supplies the condition call; absence is not inferred merely from absence of effusion.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Synovial recess/lining margin alongside bright suprapatellar fluid. The report establishes thickened synovial tissue and chronic reactive synovitis. The support is a rough lining-bearing interface, not pure synovium; the first bone-dominated rectangle was withdrawn.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Baker's
categories.subject: gastrocnemius_semimembranosus_bursa
categories.identity: Posteromedial gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursal site, distinguished from vessels and other posterior fluid.

normal.visual_reading: Posteromedial bursal-site context without the lobulated fluid expansion shown by the positive. Official Baker label is 0. This is an absence-bearing site, not a mask claiming an expanded bursa exists.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Conspicuous lobulated fluid-bright posteromedial structure, separate from the vessel course; report explicitly calls a Baker cyst at this site.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Contusion
categories.subject: femur
categories.identity: Marrow within an established bone; marrow change is a state question, not a different bone identity.

normal.visual_reading: Medial femoral marrow inside the cortex, away from joint fluid. Report states no significant marrow signal alteration.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Peripheral medial femoral marrow high-signal focus inside the bone. The report separately localizes medial-condyle marrow oedema without associated fracture; do not import the lateral fracture into this site.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

categories.question: Fracture
categories.subject: tibia
categories.identity: Tibial articular bone/spine and continuity, with the joint and femur providing context.
categories.normal_reference: Preserved bone continuity at the pictured site.

normal.visual_reading: Intact central tibial plateau/spine interface. Official Fracture=0 and report without marrow alteration teach this condition-negative presentation.
normal.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation

diagnosed.visual_reading: Abnormal tibial spine/articular interface with displaced/irregular bone structure. Report localizes comminuted tibial spine/plateau fracture; edema alone is not the defining fracture distinction.
diagnosed.scope: pictured question-bearing region; rough support, not pure tissue or a complete segmentation
